execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: KCK-03B2 individual model-sheet candidate, NOT animation or production. Input image 1 is the ONLY approved identity and rendering reference. Keep the exact Soft Handmade 2.5D illustrator treatment: dark warm brown hand outline, controlled fine paper/pencil grain, flat base colors with gentle volume, soft upper-left light. One isolated whole-body character only, genuine transparent background; no text, labels, panels, duplicates, floor, cast shadow, white matte or new props. Square canvas; entire ears, tail, feet and required prop inside a generous transparent margin on all sides. Keep approximately the same character mass/size and proportions across sheets; do not enlarge the head or shrink limbs. Eyes keep reference anatomy: large primary white glint in the UPPER LEFT of each visible open eye, small secondary glint LOWER RIGHT. Light direction is SCREEN upper left regardless of body rotation. Do not mirror the reference or transfer props between anatomical hands. This is one still PNG, no collage. Subject: approved orange-and-cream tabby Cat cat-02. Round broad head, pink inner ears and cheeks, brown iris AND visible white sclera, small brown nose, smile and tongue, three whiskers each side, clearly striped body and long curled striped tail, seated short-legged body with two cream feet. Raised pad-visible paw is the CAT'S LEFT paw (viewer right in front view); retain pink large central pad and three small toe pads. Other forepaw rests low. Keep original proportions and palette, no hair strands, clothing or accessories. View: strict orthographic BACK, head and torso face away. No visible eyes, nose, mouth, cheek circles or front belly panel. Preserve anatomical handedness: raised LEFT paw or magnifying-glass hand now on viewer LEFT. Show plausible continuous tabby stripes or yellow dorsal spine/tail in same reference style; any previously unseen back detail is a proposed candidate, do not invent decorations. Keep pose and full-body proportions. Keep the SAME grounded tail pose: tail rests low on ground and wraps toward the FRONT feet, which are on the far side from this BACK camera. Show only anatomically visible tail root/low rear curve; never raise the tail upright behind the Cat. Raised anatomical LEFT paw remains on screen LEFT in BACK view; palm/pads face forward away from camera, so show the striped back of that paw, not a pink front pad pasted on its rear. No eyes, nose, mouth, inner-ear triangles or front cream belly visible from back.
